title: Adapt finite legacy document export families to controlled datasets
description: Users select existing legacy document export families and configure approved columns/date/status filters in generic reporting. Adapt ALL 16 BillProc Bills entries through one trusted read-only family catalog, not one business report. Reuse verified existing export column/order/null semantics. Never invoke their write stored procedures. Stage 2 only. Preserve every existing route until ALL fixed/dynamic migrations have actual data, permission and Excel/PDF compatibility. No dedicated report controller/designer/exporter, arbitrary SQL/identifiers/joins, production operations, schema/seed/migration changes, secrets/env changes or permission expansion. Keep existing Domain/Application/Infrastructure/Api layering. Real writes in tests only after guard (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance and NEWERP_AUTOTEST_*; missing legacy schema/browser acceptance is an accurate environment blocker, not passed parity. Verified exact menu boundary from SeedData.Menus.cs: {"stock-in": ["stock-in"], "stock-out": ["stock-out"], "receipt": ["receipt"], "payment": ["payment"], "deposit-apply": ["deposit-apply"], "payment-apply": ["payment-apply"], "container-settlement": ["container-settlement"], "bulk-settlement": ["bulk-settlement"], "complaint": ["complaint"], "receiving-plan": ["receiving-plan"], "booking": ["booking"], "pre-loading": ["pre-loading"], "loading-list": ["loading-list"], "sales-order": ["sales-order", "sales-order-export"], "purchase-order": ["purchase-order", "purchase-order-export"], "inquiry": ["inquiry", "inquiry-export"]}; require ALL listed grants per family, including dedicated export menu when present; no SeedData edits.
acceptance_criteria: Create a finite server-owned catalog for all 16 Bills entries and ExportColumns sets, exact known table/column/date mappings and one preset per family. Expand export:bill-proc inventory into explicit family keys so the aggregate cannot hide omitted families. Reject unknown/malformed identifiers before opening a query; bound rows/time/page/date ranges. Use parameterized values and only trusted constant identifiers, no SELECT * or model-supplied SQL.

Map every family to real existing functional menu code(s) verified in source. Recheck identity, enabled account/roles/menu and SalespersonDataScopeService before catalog/query/export. Unscoped legacy tables require privileged full scope; restricted users fail closed until exact ownership mapping exists. Missing menu/schema/legacy Oid-vs-Id incompatibility yields bounded audited errors, never guesses or grants. Do not touch old write routes or production tables.

Preserve legacy field order, raw currency/unit values, nulls, status/date/keyword semantics and one-row-per-header grain through generic exports. Tests cover every finite family, injection attempts, missing columns, denied/revoked rights, source bounds and nonempty safe data/output comparisons; guarded isolated SQL fixture covers trusted reader. Run related tests and safe Release build/unit suite; record actual schema/browser gaps without declaring parity from catalog availability.
implementation_evidence: Verified BillProcController.cs Bills contains 16 types, Export.cs ExportColumns and Export GET route use finite tables but user-supplied dateField/SELECT * and no menu-specific adapter. ReportMigrationRegistryDtos.cs export:bill-proc has empty RequiredMenuCodes and only one aggregate key; existing providers/presets/tasks 295-307 have no BillProc family migration. Existing legacy db_owner columns use Oid while EF uses Id: verify exact shape and fail closed, no schema modification. SeedData.Menus.cs lines33-61 verifies all16 exact functional menus; sales-order/purchase-order/inquiry also have separate export menu grants, which must be retained rather than substituting general menu alone.
